description: This header file declares an interface for interacting with a file system monitor daemon via inter-process communication (IPC) mechanisms like pipes or sockets. It includes function prototypes to check support, retrieve IPC paths, determine daemon state, query for changed files, and send commands.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__is_supported
methods.description: Checks if the built-in file system monitor daemon is supported on this platform.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_path
methods.description: Retrieves the path to the IPC pipe or Unix domain socket for the daemon, specific to a repository.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_state
methods.description: Determines whether the daemon process is active or listening.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_query
methods.description: Connects to the daemon to request the list of changed files since a given token.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_command
methods.description: Sends a command verb to the daemon without attempting to start one if none are running.
